payload.title: Which hyp commit implements the end act?
payload.body: Each Hypothesis is one commit on feat/goal-end. Its rival is the base 8cd0c6ec194e4f281591c97866bfa7d6d76eafb5: each new test of lines 1 to 7 is red on the base and green on the candidate, except line 7's last sentence, green on both. Lines 8 and 9 are skill prose, judged by the skill review each Experiment's rubric names.

why: The grill adds the Goal's top-level question; in a build Goal the run adds one Hypothesis per commit
